title: Artificial Intelligence in Sports: Revolutionizing Performance and Fan Engagement
description: Artificial intelligence enhances sports with performance analytics, injury prevention, and immersive fan experiences.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in Sports, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in Sports, including coaches, analysts, operators, and fans who want the practical view.
